scope: Add a compact net-profit column to every Dashboard advertising account/provider/direct/total row. Hover, focus or click the total FOOTER row to compare all shown accounts in two Riyadh half-day tables and view authoritative totals below. The header remains unchanged as a non-trigger.
acceptance: Preserve the existing Dashboard grid/card width; display six main columns with compact SAR and native spend.
Use existing stats.profit.complete/netProfit/provisional without recalculating profit, adding operating costs or introducing new reads.

Use total.segments for half-day totals and total for the full period; never sum rounded displayed profits or override financial scope guards.
Direct orders retain unavailable advertising spend/CPA, with their supplied non-advertising net profit.
Keep one locally rendered popup active, support mouse/touch/keyboard and small-screen scrolling, and suppress false half-day splits for multi-day ranges.
